title: Home Oxygen Therapy
source: CMS National Coverage Determination style criteria (synthetic)

required_documentation.description: Qualifying hypoxemia test result (resting, exercise, or nocturnal SpO2/ABG) within the last 30 days.

criteria: Resting, exercise, or nocturnal oxygen saturation testing within the last 30 days shows SpO2 <= 88% (or PaO2 <= 55 mmHg on ABG), OR SpO2 <= 89% with evidence of cor pulmonale/erythrocytosis.
The underlying condition causing hypoxemia is documented (e.g., COPD, interstitial lung disease, heart failure).
A treating physician has ordered home oxygen therapy and specified the flow rate/duration (continuous, nocturnal, or exertional).
No contraindication (e.g., active home oxygen safety hazard) is documented.
notes: Synthetic policy created for this demo; not an actual CMS NCD.
